# Sanitisation lint — generic patterns only.
# Specific personal/project names are checked by the maintainer's local
# pre-commit hook, not by this CI workflow.

# Windows absolute paths with a personal-looking username segment.
# Catches accidental commits of dev-machine paths.
C:\\Users\\[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]+\\

# AppData paths embedded as literal strings (placeholders allowed via <token>).
%APPDATA%\\Claude\\claude-code-sessions\\[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-

# Email addresses (catches accidental inclusion in commit footers / comments).
[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.(com|org|net|io|dev)

# Common API key shapes.
sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}
ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}
